# Askan Technologies

> AI-driven custom software development company based in Pondicherry, India, specializing in Angular, Laravel, Flutter, and enterprise web applications with a focus on innovation and education.

Askan Technologies is an ISO 9001-2015 certified IT solutions provider offering custom software development, mobile app development, and AI-powered business automation. The company actively engages with engineering colleges in Tamil Nadu, hosting industrial visits and providing career opportunities for students in software development, data science, and business development roles.

## Key Topics

- Angular Development
- Laravel Development
- Flutter & Mobile Apps
- Generative AI & Machine Learning
- Shopify Integration
- TypeScript & React
- Cybersecurity
- Firebase & JWT Authentication
- Custom Software Development
- E-commerce Solutions
- Business Automation
- Blockchain CMS
- Career Opportunities in Pondicherry
- Engineering Education & Industrial Visits
